questions.text: CSS 2016, 2026 · Pair: Moat / Mote — Which meaning fits “Moat”?

options.A: A deep, wide ditch, usually filled with water, around a castle or fort
options.B: A period of time; during the time that
options.C: A person who leaves their own country to settle in another
options.D: A tiny particle or speck of dust

questions.explanation:
Moat: A deep, wide ditch, usually filled with water, around a castle or fort. Sentence: "The fort was surrounded by a moat, so attackers had to cross the water before reaching the walls."
Mote: A tiny speck, especially of dust. Sentence: "In the shaft of sunlight we could see every mote of dust floating in the air."
Source: CSS 2016, 2026 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2026 · Pair: Dependant / Dependent — Which meaning fits “Dependant”?

options.A: (British, noun) a person who relies on another, especially financially
options.C: A story or deed of adventure, especially a heroic exploit (also 'geste')
options.D: Relying on or determined by something (adjective)

questions.explanation:
Dependant: (British, noun) a person who relies on another, especially financially. Sentence: "The tax form asks you to list each dependant, such as your children and elderly parents."
Dependent: (Adjective) relying on someone or something for support; determined by. Sentence: "Pakistan's crops are heavily dependent on the monsoon rains."
Source: CSS 2026 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2026 · Pair: Funeral / Funereal — Which meaning fits “Funeral”?

options.A: A vegetable related to the onion, with a long white stem
options.B: A ceremony held for burying or cremating a dead person
options.C: To draw out a response, answer or reaction
options.D: Gloomy and sad, suitable for a burial

questions.explanation:
Funeral: A ceremony held for burying or cremating a dead person. Sentence: "Thousands of mourners attended the funeral of the beloved poet."
Funereal: Gloomy, solemn or mournful, as if suitable for a funeral. Sentence: "The office had a funereal atmosphere after the company announced job cuts."
Source: CSS 2026 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2026 · Pair: Fain / Feign — Which meaning fits “Fain”?

options.C: A projecting corner of a wall; 'coign of vantage' = a good viewpoint
options.D: A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country

questions.explanation:
Fain: (Archaic) gladly, willingly; or obliged/compelled. Sentence: "The weary traveller would fain have rested, but the storm forced him to keep walking."
Feign: To pretend to be affected by a feeling or state. Sentence: "The boy feigned illness so that he would not have to go to school."
Source: CSS 2026 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2026 · Pair: Gamble / Gambol — Which meaning fits “Gamble”?

options.A: To bet money on an uncertain outcome; a risky action
options.B: To run or jump about playfully
options.C: The roof of the mouth; a person's sense of taste
options.D: A foolish, grotesque or funny act (usually plural: antics)

questions.explanation:
Gamble: To bet money on an uncertain outcome; a risky action. Sentence: "He gambled his entire salary at cards and lost it all; starting a business is always a gamble."
Gambol: To run or jump about playfully. Sentence: "The lambs gambolled happily in the green meadow."
Source: CSS 2026 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2026 · Pair: Hoard / Horde — Which meaning fits “Hoard”?

options.A: An insulting or mocking remark; to taunt
options.C: A hidden store of money or valuables; to collect and hide
options.D: (British, Liverpool/Merseyside slang) a foolish or stupid person

questions.explanation:
Hoard: A hidden store of money or valuables; to collect and hide. Sentence: "During the shortage, some traders hoarded sugar to sell later at higher prices."
Horde: A large crowd of people, often disorderly or threatening. Sentence: "A horde of fans rushed onto the pitch after the final ball."
Source: CSS 2026 English Precis & Composition (cssaspirants.pk).

questions.text: CSS 2026 · Pair: Ingenious / Ingenuous — Which meaning fits “Ingenious”?

options.C: A short, witty saying expressing a clever idea
options.D: A small open boat, often carried by a larger ship or used for leisure

questions.explanation:
Ingenious: Clever, original and inventive. Sentence: "The boy built an ingenious water pump from an old bicycle wheel."
Ingenuous: Innocent, naive and unsuspecting; frank. Sentence: "The ingenuous young man believed every promise the salesman made."
